text: brought my cat in to check for a UTI infection because she was peeing everywhere and was having problems. they took a test said she had kidney stones bc she was drinking too little water, but my cat has always been drinking a-lot so i was already skeptic. So they gave me medicine for her to take for a week and after i took her in for a second test. they had told me that she no longer had kidney stones and only had to take a medicine from 2 tubes which costed 1800baht. i have been giving her the medicine everyday and now it seems that she still is sick. Not only did i pay a-lot of money for medicine and for the tests but also she is still sick. don’t go to this clinic i don’t recommend it.
